name: Sunday Machine
tagline: The church back office that runs itself between services
positioning: Membership, giving, and volunteer scheduling for small churches run by people who'd rather be doing literally anything pastoral.

hero.h1: Church admin that doesn't require a burning bush
hero.sub: Track members, count the offering, and wrangle volunteers without a spreadsheet named 'FINAL_v7_USE_THIS.xlsx.' Sunday Machine keeps the boring stuff running so you can go do the meaningful stuff.

features.title: Giving that reconciles itself
features.description: Log cash, checks, and online tithes in one ledger. Year-end contribution statements generate in a click instead of a January panic.

features.title: Volunteer scheduling, minus the guilt
features.description: Fill the nursery, sound board, and coffee station with auto-reminders that nag people so you don't have to. Swaps happen without a group text war.

features.title: A directory people actually update
features.description: Members manage their own info, so your database stops thinking the Hendersons still live three houses ago. Photos, families, and groups included.

features.title: Attendance without clipboards
features.description: Check-in kids with printed name tags and pickup tags. Track service counts and small-group attendance without a single tally mark on a bulletin.

features.title: Communication that lands
features.description: Send email and text blasts to the exact group you mean, not the whole church. Weather cancellations go out in under a minute.

features.title: Reports for the board meeting
features.description: Giving trends, attendance, and budget dashboards the treasurer can read without a seminary degree. Export to PDF and look competent.

testimonials.quote: We ran a 140-person church on three overlapping spreadsheets and a prayer. Now the prayer is optional. Year-end statements took me twenty minutes instead of a full weekend of crying.
testimonials.name: Pastor Dave Okafor

testimonials.quote: Our volunteers stopped ghosting the nursery because the reminders are relentless in the nicest way. I have not sent a passive-aggressive group text in eight months.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The treasurer used to email me PDFs at midnight. Now she just opens the dashboard. I didn't know church finances could be this calm.
testimonials.name: Reverend Tom Brady

pricing.blurb: For the one-and-a-half-person office running a small congregation.
For growing churches with actual staff and actual chaos.
Multi-site churches and networks that outgrew normal software.

homepage.footerBlurb: Sunday Machine is church admin software for people who got into ministry for the ministry part. Made by folks who've stacked enough chairs to know.
